data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper for Klaviyo push messaging and analytics
data.what_it_does: Provides integration with Klaviyo’s Android and iOS SDKs, enabling push notifications and event tracking in Flutter apps. It forwards Firebase tokens to Klaviyo and logs events via the Klaviyo API.
use_when: You need push notifications and analytics from Klaviyo in a Flutter app
You already use Firebase Messaging for push delivery
avoid_when: You prefer a pure Dart solution without native SDKs
You need only analytics without push support
strengths: Native SDK integration for reliable push handling
Supports setting profile attributes and badge counts
Handles token forwarding and event logging
Compatible with Android SDK 23+ and iOS 13+
weaknesses: Requires native Android/iOS setup and permissions
data.setup_notes: Add Firebase Messaging plugin, configure Android permissions (INTERNET, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, etc.), add KlaviyoPushService to Android manifest, set iOS Info.plist keys, initialize Klaviyo with API key, send Firebase token to Klaviyo
